Game Overview

In Otaho Bird 2, the core idea is straightforward: guide a brave bird in Otaho Bird 2, a thrilling 2D adventure. Dodge enemy birds, evade fiery traps, and gather bread in eight action-packed levels. Navigate tricky paths and conquer escalating challenges, testing your agility and strategy as you aim to reach the safety of your nest.
